description: Render a post's reel: a short vertical video from its images, one short line per tile. The post needs at least one image (update_social_post with media_ids). Without lines the lines stored at the post are used. Takes up to half a minute and replaces an existing reel. Nothing is posted: the user shares it.

lines.description: 2–10 short lines (up to 80 characters), one per tile, in the user's language.

name: render_social_reel
title: Render a reel
